title: The Slow Draft
tagline: Essays on writing, building things, and paying attention.

hero.heading: Notes from the slow lane of the internet.
hero.intro: Long-ish thoughts on writing, craft, and the small systems that keep a creative life running. New pieces land here every couple of weeks — you can also get them by email.

author.name: Chirag Yadav
author.shortBio: I'm Chirag — a student, and an active reader. This site is where I keep what I'm learning: notes from the books I'm reading, essays about writing and attention, and the occasional thing I build while I'm figuring things

newsletter.heading: Letters, occasionally
newsletter.blurb: One short email when something new goes up. No spam, no selling your address, unsubscribe in one click.

footerNote: Written by hand, published from a small editor.
